findings.highlight: I wake up up at the same time as usual
findings.evidenceJa: いつも通りの時間に目を覚ます
findings.governingReading: Shirou wakes at his usual time.
findings.explanation: The English duplicates “up,” producing an elementary grammatical error.

findings.highlight: The day is dawning
findings.evidenceJa: 夜明けを迎えたばかりの空は薄暗く
findings.governingReading: The sky is still dim just after dawn.
findings.explanation: The English changes the completed arrival of dawn into an ongoing dawn and omits the dimness.

findings.highlight: She must mean the black shadow
findings.evidenceJa: 出てこなかった、とはあの“黒い影”のことだ
findings.governingReading: The narration directly identifies Rin’s omitted subject as the black shadow.
findings.explanation: The English adds uncertainty about the referent.

findings.highlight: hundreds of people getting hurt
findings.evidenceJa: 百人単位の被害
findings.governingReading: Rin speaks of casualties or damage on the scale of hundreds of people.
findings.explanation: The English narrows the casualties to people being hurt.

findings.highlight: Sakura and Illya are both sleeping
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は客間で眠っており
findings.governingReading: Sakura is sleeping specifically in the guest room, while Illya is also asleep.
findings.explanation: The English removes Sakura’s location and merges the two sleeping states.

findings.highlight: We’ll complete the framework today
findings.evidenceJa: なんとか今日中に骨組みが出来る
findings.governingReading: Rin expects to manage to get the framework ready sometime today.
findings.explanation: The English removes the difficulty and presents completion as certain.

findings.highlight: settle our match with Zouken
findings.evidenceJa: 臓硯と決着をつける
findings.governingReading: Rin plans to bring the conflict with Zouken to a decisive conclusion.
findings.explanation: The English recasts the lethal confrontation as a match.

findings.highlight: the Holy Grail summoned it
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯に呼ばれている
findings.governingReading: Rin does not know whether the shadow desires the Grail or is being called by it.
findings.explanation: The English upgrades being called or drawn to the Grail into technical summoning.

findings.highlight: Already… Knew what that shadow is?
findings.evidenceJa: とっくの昔に、あの影の正体を知っていた
findings.governingReading: Shirou suspects Rin knew the shadow’s identity long ago.
findings.explanation: The English preserves prior knowledge but drops how far back he imagines it extending.

findings.highlight: We can’t rely on uncertainties like obtaining the Holy Grail ourselves
findings.evidenceJa: 手に入るかどうかも分からない聖杯なんかには頼れない
findings.governingReading: They cannot rely on a Grail they do not even know they can obtain.
findings.explanation: The English turns the Grail itself into an abstract uncertainty and adds “ourselves.”

findings.highlight: you’ll be a liability in your condition
findings.evidenceJa: そんな体でいられちゃわたしたちが困る
findings.governingReading: Rin says Shirou remaining in that bodily state creates trouble for all of them.
findings.explanation: The English labels Shirou himself a liability, making her care sound more instrumental.

findings.highlight: You’re so tired that you don’t even notice it
findings.evidenceJa: 自覚がないほど参ってた
findings.governingReading: Rin says Shirou was so badly worn down or overwhelmed that he lacked awareness of it.
findings.explanation: The English reduces his disturbed condition to tiredness.

findings.highlight: I’ll go get you in the afternoon
findings.evidenceJa: 夕方になったら呼びにいく
findings.governingReading: Rin promises to wake or fetch Shirou in the evening.
findings.explanation: The English moves the planned wake-up earlier into the afternoon.

findings.highlight: I might be able to do something like sleep suggestion
findings.evidenceJa: 眠りの暗示ぐらいなら即興で出来そう
findings.governingReading: Rin thinks she may be able to improvise a sleep suggestion on the spot.
findings.explanation: The English omits the improvisational claim and weakens the specific act into “something like” it.

findings.highlight: she might test it on me if I do object
findings.evidenceJa: それじゃ試してみる？　なんて言われそう
findings.governingReading: Shirou stays quiet because Rin might answer his objection by asking whether he wants to try it.
findings.explanation: The English changes a feared teasing offer into Rin testing him without consent.

findings.highlight: I’m not that sensitive
findings.evidenceJa: それほど神経質ってワケでもない
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he is not especially high-strung or nervous and can sleep if he decides to.
findings.explanation: The English uses the broader “sensitive,” weakening the sleep-related temperament claim.

findings.highlight: I’ll take her offer
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の好意に甘えよう
findings.governingReading: Shirou decides to depend on and accept Rin’s kindness.
findings.explanation: The English turns an explicitly relational acknowledgment of kindness into accepting an offer.

findings.highlight: scold her and put her back in bed
findings.evidenceJa: 叱りつけて眠らせる
findings.governingReading: Rin jokes that if Sakura moves on her own, she will scold her and make her sleep.
findings.explanation: The English replaces induced sleep with physically returning her to bed.

findings.highlight: geniuses tend to leave everyone else behind them
findings.evidenceJa: 天才肌の人間は相手を置いてけぼりにする
findings.governingReading: People with a natural genius disposition are said to leave the person dealing with them behind.
findings.explanation: The English broadens the immediate interlocutor into everyone else.

findings.highlight: Sakura and Tohsaka can be together again
findings.evidenceJa: 桜と遠坂は姉妹に戻れる
findings.governingReading: Once the interfamily arrangement disappears, Sakura and Rin can return to being sisters.
findings.explanation: The English reduces restored sisterhood to physical or social togetherness.

findings.highlight: the most I can do for Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: 桜にとって一番大きな贈り物
findings.governingReading: Shirou believes renewed sisterhood would be the greatest gift for Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English changes the value of the gift to a limit on Shirou’s capacity.

findings.highlight: Protect her until the Holy Grail War ends
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯戦争が終わるまで桜を守りきる
findings.governingReading: The sole plan Shirou sees is to protect Sakura successfully all the way through the war’s end.
findings.explanation: The English drops the completion and perseverance encoded in protecting her through.

findings.highlight: wait for the duration of the war
findings.evidenceJa: 戦いの期限切れを待てばいい
findings.governingReading: Under Shirou’s conditional plan, they can wait for the war’s time limit to expire.
findings.explanation: The English says to wait for its duration, obscuring the expiration condition.

findings.highlight: we’ll challenge Zouken tonight
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は今夜のうちに臓硯に挑む
findings.governingReading: Rin said that she would challenge Zouken tonight.
findings.explanation: The English changes Rin’s planned agency into a joint action.

findings.highlight: Then we can beat Zouken
findings.evidenceJa: なら臓硯は倒せる
findings.governingReading: Shirou infers from Rin’s willingness to fight that Zouken can be defeated.
findings.explanation: The English assigns the victory specifically to “we,” adding participants to the inference.

findings.highlight: that thing came from the Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯の中からこぼれてくるモノ
findings.governingReading: Shirou hypothesizes that the shadow is something spilling out from inside the Grail.
findings.explanation: The English removes the overflow image and the inside/outside relation.

findings.highlight: If I’m to eliminate it, I have to
findings.evidenceJa: もしアレを消せるとしたら
findings.governingReading: Shirou conditionally reasons that if the shadow can be erased at all, perhaps only its projector or supplying source can be erased.
findings.explanation: The English turns a speculative boundary on possibility into actions he personally has to take.

findings.highlight: magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=でんりょく char=2]魔力
findings.governingReading: The written term is magical energy while its ruby reads electricity, sustaining the projector analogy.
findings.explanation: The English retains only magical energy and loses the electrical reading.

findings.highlight: implanted within Sakura a piece of the Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯の欠片を桜に埋め込んだ
findings.governingReading: Zouken implanted fragments of the shattered Grail into Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English singularizes the implanted fragments.

findings.highlight: extracted some crest worm
findings.evidenceJa: 刻印虫を摘出した
findings.governingReading: Kirei surgically extracted crest worms from Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English uses “worm” as an ungrammatical mass singular and obscures the extracted entities.

findings.highlight: one of the last surviving Masters in the previous war
findings.evidenceJa: 前回の戦いで最後まで残ったマスター
findings.governingReading: Kirei was the Master who remained through to the end of the previous war.
findings.explanation: The English weakens his singular final-survivor status into membership in a group of late survivors.

findings.highlight: The shadow that appears as Sakura’s subconscious form
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の無意識の姿で現れる影
findings.governingReading: The shadow appears in the form taken by Sakura’s unconscious state or unconscious self.
findings.explanation: The English turns the manifested unconscious form into a psychological “subconscious form.”
